ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)

   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
